newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Jospin to make policy statement soon.
newsitem.headline: France's Jospin to make policy statement soon.

text.p: France's new Socialist Prime Minister Lionel Jospin plans to make a general statement of government policy in a few days, government spokeswoman Catherine Trautmann said on Thursday.
"The prime minister will make a declaration of general policy and announce his calendar and priorities in a few days," she told France 2 in a broadcast interview.

"At the present time, the various members of the government are drafting lists of urgent tasks and at the same time lists of what should be proposed to the prime minister as new priorities. So this matter is going forward progressively," she added.

France's new leftist cabinet, announced on Wednesday night, fanned out across Paris on Thursday to take over their respective ministries in a series of ceremonies marking the formal transition of power.
A leftist alliance including Socialists, Communists and Greens swept into power last Sunday in an upset parliamentary election victory over the previous centre-right majority.
"Our team is ready to work, drawn together, motivated, enthusiastic," the spokeswoman said.
Trautmann, who was named culture and communication minister as well as spokeswoman, said the government planned to work closely together in a collegial atmosphere.
